name: MatchZy
description: 5v5 matches and scrims: ready-up, knife round, side pick, pause, coach, backups of every round, demos and stats. Practice mode with grenade trajectories (.prac).

name: Retakes
description: Retakes: every round starts with the bomb planted and the CTs retaking the site. Spawns for the active duty maps are included.

name: Instadefuse
description: A CT defuses instantly when nothing can stop the defuse any more. Made for retakes.

name: Clutch Announce
description: Announces clutches (1vX wins) in chat. Made for retakes.

name: Deathmatch
description: Custom deathmatch: gun menus, custom spawns, several modes in rotation, headshot-only and pistol rounds. Use it with the Deathmatch game mode.

name: GG1 MapChooser
description: Map votes at the end of each match, !rtv (rock the vote) and !nominate, among the maps of your map cycle (the panel writes its list, cfg/GGMCmaps.json, when you save the cycle).
